patterns.regex: Transaction of (?:Rs\.?|INR)\s*(?<amount>[\d,]+(?:\.\d{1,2})?) made on your SBI Credit Card ending (?<account>\d{4}) at (?<merchant>.+?) on (?<date>\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{2})
